formation.text: Remove “older” from “an older variant spelling.” The evidence supports variant status and examples from Song–Yuan onward, but does not establish that 体 predates 體. Evidence: X-b5525f891acf53981c53, X-610a1ebe5449fd673c96.

learner.overview: Replace the sentence foregrounding the separate bèn reading with a brief explanation of 体 as the simplified form used for 體, meaning “body.” The bèn use and its unresolved connection are already covered in the expert account and are peripheral to the first-reading explanation.
